name: Missionary
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to actively engage in missionary work by spreading the gospel to all nations and every creature, as Jesus instructed His followers to go into the world with His message. This mission is rooted in the sending nature of Christ Himself, who sends His disciples just as the Father sent Him. Believers are called to be a light to the Gentiles, carrying salvation to the ends of the earth, fulfilling God's directive to publish the gospel universally.
